title: Verify an installed robot suction cup holds vacuum
instruction: Open the vacuum supply and seat the aluminum test plate against the suction cup. Isolate the supply and let the cup hold the plate on its own for two seconds with at least 40 kilopascals of vacuum. Support the plate before pressing the vent and return it to its rest.
context: Commission an installed cobot suction gripper for automated pick-and-place. A running vacuum source can mask a leaking cup. Isolating the circuit while the tool holds a known nonporous plate proves the installed cup can retain its grip. One arm seats and supports the plate while the other works the pressure circuit.
setup: A down-facing 52 mm rubber bellows cup hangs on a fixed cobot vacuum head with the lip 172.5 mm above the worktop. A 107 × 91 × 7 mm aluminum plate with a blue handling tab lies on two padded rails to its left. A downstream 0–80 kPa gauge, blue push-pull supply spool, and orange spring vent sit on the stand. Start at atmospheric pressure with the supply isolated. See the README for sizes, material, plumbing and datums.
scoring: 0.35 when the compressed rim physically seals against the elevated plate at 40 kPa or above with supply running. 0.75 after two continuous seconds of hands-off retention at 40 kPa or above with supply isolated. 1.0 after holding the plate through venting and returning it level to its rest with the gauge below 3 kPa, supply isolated, and hands clear for half a second. Venting the elevated plate without load-bearing hand contact caps the score at 0.75.
reset_notes: Clean the cup and test plate. Start with the plate flat across both rest rails, the supply closed, the vent released and the gauge at zero.
fidelity: The full-size plate and cup use native contacts. A compliant axial and angular bellows mount allows the rim to seat on the plate. Seal scoring requires rim compression and measured contact load. Gauge pressure and leakage use a lumped air model with pressure–area force applied to the plate. Vent support comes from measured gripper contact forces.
scores: Demo: 1.0 in 488 actions. Dream-1: 0.0 after 780 actions.
